prompt:
Generate a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA sprite sheet of Xiaohan, the same cream-white fluffy Samoyed dog in the three supplied character references. Preserve delicate warm storybook drawing, gentle black eyes/nose, curled fluffy tail, upright triangular ears or ears swept backwards (never floppy). A cozy desktop pet needs to go potty and fidgets impatiently; no elimination, no fluids, no excrement, no anatomy details. Dog looks mildly anxious and expectant with closed mouth, glancing up, hindquarters slightly tucked, shifting weight between paws, not sick or injured.
EXACTLY 3 columns x 6 rows, 18 distinct full-body sprites with very large TRANSPARENT gutters (at least 30 pixels between silhouettes). Columns: round short-legged PUPPY; slimmer adolescent TEEN; full size ADULT. Each column consistent size across all six rows. ROWS1-2 blue chest harness with gold badge, ROWS3-4 red triangular neckerchief only, ROWS5-6 warm yellow vest with blue trim. Odd rows animation frame0: weight on right forepaw, left forepaw lifted slightly. Even rows frame1: alternate weight on left forepaw, right forepaw lifted slightly and glance a little to other side. Body/head scale and location almost identical within each pair; difference is a little restless paw shuffle. All four limbs anatomically correct, full ears/tail/paws visible. Front three-quarter slightly LEFT. Maintain proportions and identity, keep a friendly gentle face; not grimacing, not angry, no bared teeth. Each sprite isolated on ZERO ALPHA background. NO white or gray paper, no gradient, no shadows, no ground, no props, no lettering, no checkered backdrop. Tall high resolution sheet.

Do not add any new backdrop, paper, shadows, checkerboard, text or props. Output the isolated dog sprites on transparent RGBA. This file will be pasted over arbitrary desktop wallpapers; any brown or gray area outside a dog is an error.
